diameterInterpretation: Convex light-curve reconstruction. Thermophysical size-calibrated diameter: 3.5 ± 0.4 km. Grid marks unavailable mapped imagery; rotational phase is illustrative.

calibration.uncertaintyKind: Selected archive diameter uncertainty; absent value remains unknown. It is not local shape accuracy.
calibration.diameterSemantics: Volume-equivalent diameter in the selected DAMIT record, calibrated with radar for Tantalus and thermophysical data for the other bodies.
calibration.limitations: Published 2018 YORP/thermophysical solution; rotation uses the fixed published reference period, with arbitrary display phase and no runtime YORP propagation. The original shape is uniformly scaled to the selected archive diameter. Quoted diameter fit uncertainty does not describe local shape accuracy. No albedo, craters or regolith map is inferred. The archive symmetrizes its size uncertainty to±0.4 km; Ďurech et al.2018 report 3.5 km with an asymmetric -0.4/+0.3 km interval.
calibration.visibleDescription: Convex lightcurve model with thermophysical diameter 3.5 km (published interval 3.1–3.8 km). Grid marks unavailable imagery; phase is illustrative.
